description: Champion's Battlegear Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest. Requirements: - Cenarion Combat Badge x 15 - Cenarion Logistics Badge x 20 - Cenarion Tactical Badge x 20 - Mark of Cenarius - Cenarion Circle:
